change.before: "argocd server does not pass the appLabelKey for caching"
change.after: "argocd server passes the appLabelKey for proper caching"

original.statement: The argocd server component now passes the appLabelKey parameter for proper caching, fixing a previous behavior where it did not.

decision.reason: [ev-602e50572fe9] is a one-line bug-fix title saying the argocd server now passes the appLabelKey for proper caching. That is an internal caching fix, not wire/protocol behaviour, so protocol-behavior is the wrong family. The name "appLabelKey-caching" also breaks the lowercase kebab-case rule. The before/after values only paraphrase the title, and the evidence names no config key, flag or other typed subject, so no correct assertion follows from it (the PR #22186 would be needed).
